Sixty-ninth daf of the campaign, and the first non-sequential queue jump: docs/rashi-audit-backlog.md's freshly-regenerated 'Current next reconstruction target' pointed to 4a, not 77a, because the queue is driven by the live scaffold-debt baseline, not simple daf-number sequence. 4a's docs-table task recommendation read 'rashi-narration-repair', a display-only label (rashi_task_type_map.json's defaultForPlainMetaOnly) that does not exist as a real worker_pipeline.py task type (RASHI_TYPES only recognizes rashi-repair/rashi-reconstruction/rashi-realignment/placeholder-backfill/rashi-structural-repair). Pre-edit drift profile was ALIGNED (3/4 anchors, one missing) despite the scaffold debt, because scaffold narration and semantic drift are different failure modes; the drift profile alone does not certify content correctness, which is why the full Sefaria cross-check step is mandatory regardless of classification.

Live-fetched Sefaria API v3 Rashi_on_Yoma.4a (11 LINE positions), which map to this daf's 12 legal ids as 11 non-empty + 1 empty: l01a, l01b, l06, l09, l15, l18, l24, l28, l31, l35, l40, l42[empty]. (2) a raw-source-vs-Sefaria physical ordering difference: the printer interposes the l18 dibbur ('וכשם שמפרישים... מעלה בעלמא') physically between the two l15 dibburim ('לאפוקי צדוקים...' and 'לחנכו - ללמדו:'); translated in the raw source's own physical line order (entries 25-30 stay in raw order) but linked each entry to its Sefaria content-match target (l15, l15, l15, l18, l18, l15), not by raw adjacency. (3) fake dibbur-splitting: old entries 37-49 (13 separate 'Continuing:' fragments) were actually ONE single continuous Rashi comment per Sefaria's own structure (the R. Yosi HaGelili discussion, position 10), now translated as one coherent explanation spread naturally across its 13 raw print lines but linked uniformly to its single true target l35; likewise old entries 50-55 (6 fragments) are one continuous comment (R. Akiva's view, position 11) linked to l40.

l42 (this daf's final legal id, vilna 42 'ויכסהו') carries zero independent comments; confirmed via modules/yoma/assets/talmuddev/4b.json's first raw Rashi line ('ויכסהו הענן להר. ולא למשה שהרי כל אותן ששת ימים עלה וירד...') to be the genuine start of the comment explaining that the cloud covered the mountain, not Moses, continuing onto 4b; the final entry (raw line 56, the single truncated word 'ויכסהו') is linked to l42, this daf's own final legal id, per boundary policy.

Content covers: why entering the High Priest's home for seven days risks impurity that would disqualify him from Yom Kippur service; the heifer-burning priest's parallel seven-day sequestering and sprinkling regimen derived from the Tabernacle inauguration; the extended baraita reconciling R. Yochanan's (inauguration-derived) and Reish Lakish's (Sinai-derived) accounts of the extra word 'bezot'; the exclusion of the Sadducees' altered incense procedure; the grammatical-gender argument (bezot's feminine form) proving the sequestering law applies specifically to the inauguration; the dispute over whether Aaron's seven-day sequestering law binds only him or all future High Priests; and the R. Yosi HaGelili vs. R. Akiva dispute over whether Moses' cloud-covering (Exodus 24) preceded or followed the Ten Commandments, and what the 'six days' of Exodus 24:16 refer to under each view.

Every raw-line English was checked against its own Hebrew via the build script's line-indexed ENTRIES list and a full reread of all 56 lines against the packet, the Sefaria cross-check, and 4b's opening line. audit_rashi_scaffold.py 4a --no-baseline reports 0 hits after rebuild; baseline 2564 -> 2546 via --update-baseline, verified the 18 retired entries are exclusively daf=4a with zero additions or rehashes elsewhere. No repetition-baseline or content-allowlist entry existed for 4a before or after (confirmed via the packet's validator-baseline section: content-allowlisted lines: none, count mismatch tolerance: none, repetition baseline: none). audit_rashi_association.py --range-from 4a --range-to 4a: 62 declared associations, 0 broken, 0 cross-daf, single_link=50, multi_link=6, suffixed=11. Post-edit drift profile: ALIGNED, 4/4 anchors found (up from 3/4 pre-edit), offsets [0,0,1,0]; the single offset-1 anchor (the '53a' dafnum citation, split across two raw print lines) is splitContinuation=true, and worker_pipeline.py's multi_anchor_safe() explicitly allows offset (0,1) for splitContinuation anchors, so this remains the plain multi-anchor evidence tier with no extra attestation block required. Diff scope is exactly the 7 expected files (VERSION, target learning.json, learning_data.js, the scaffold-debt baseline, docs/rashi-audit-backlog.md, package.json/package-lock.json, plus the manifest; this self-review is the 8th) with no unauthorized files touched.
